definitions.gloss: snow cover; accumulated snow; snowfall depth
definitions.explanation: Snow that has accumulated on the ground. Also used to describe the depth of accumulated snow, frequently in weather reports.

examples.japanese: {積雪|せきせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧50⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}えた→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
{積雪|せきせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{通行止|つうこうど}め→通行止め：19920_tsuukoudome⟧になった。
examples.english: The road was closed due to snow cover.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{例年|れいねん}→例年：11561_reinen⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{積雪|せきせつ}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}く→多い：01127_ooi⟧、{雪下|ゆきおろ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧だ。
examples.english: This year there's more snow accumulation than usual, making snow removal a real chore.

notes:
Commonly heard in weather forecasts and winter news reports. {積雪|せきせつ} measures the total depth of snow on the ground at a given time, as opposed to ⟦{降雪|こうせつ}→降雪：14530_kousetsu⟧ (snowfall), which measures how much new snow has fallen.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {積雪|せきせつ}⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (amount of accumulated snow)
- {積雪|せきせつ}⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧ (snow-covered region)
- {積雪|せきせつ}⟦{注意報|ちゅういほう}→注意報：16464_chuuihou⟧ (snow accumulation advisory)
- ⟦{記録的|きろくてき}→記録的：28788_kirokuteki⟧な{積雪|せきせつ} (record snowfall)

Distinguish from ⟦{降雪|こうせつ}→降雪：14530_kousetsu⟧ (snowfall — the act of snow falling) and ⟦{残雪|ざんせつ}→残雪：21062_zansetsu⟧ (lingering snow — snow remaining in spring).
